sentences.en: Blood is the fluid responsible for the circulation of nutrients.
The fuzzy skin of a kiwi contains most of its nutrients.
sentences.zh: 猕猴桃那层毛茸茸的皮肤含有其大部分营养品。

sentences.en: Xylem ensure that plants have enough water and nutrients to produce food.
sentences.zh: 木质部确保植物有足够的水分和滋养物来生产食物。

senses.zh: (食品或化学品)营养物, 营养品 -
营养物的, 营养品的
